comparison.objective: Sort folded garments by color and hand-wash tags, versus tune a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable garment grasping, perception, and placement; no rigid tool use, retained adjustment, or dynamic commissioning.
comparison.success_condition: Six garments reach rule-selected receptacles. Candidate instead passes only after safe unlocking, adjustment, relocking, and two bounded impacts.
comparison.reason: The sorting rule and deformable handling are unrelated to damper adjustment.
